Explain in your own words what 'Dual Aspect Concept and Accounting Equation' refers to.
questions.a: The fundamental postulate that every financial transaction exerts a balanced two-sided impact across accounts, maintaining structural equality between assets and claims.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Dual Aspect Concept and Accounting Equation'.
questions.a: Total resources owned by a firm equal the combined claims of owners and creditors.
